description: Open a page in a real browser and read it after its JavaScript has run. Use it when web_fetch comes back empty or with only a nav bar, which is what a page that builds itself in the browser looks like to a plain fetch. web_fetch is free and is the right first try; this costs, because it runs a browser

wait.description: Optional CSS selector to wait for before reading, for content that arrives late

name: browser_read
title: Read browser
